items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Willie Deliner, I remember, told me that he's really not a Negro... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: But first, the Jews came originally from Africa, some people say anyway. They don't know where the whole human race originated down there someplace. Maybe around Egypt or someplace or else over in Babylon. They don't know for sure. I don't think. But anyway, Willie Deliner, I remember, told me that he's really not a Negro. He's Jewish. I mean, I know he's a prejudiced kid. Yeah, he's prejudiced.
